movelist.name: Wrap
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: Ingrain
movelist.effect: Ingrain applies a Coat to the user, which has the following effect; the user cannot be pushed or pulled, and cannot be switched out.  At the beginning of each of the user’s turn, the user gains a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Thunder Shock
movelist.effect: Thunder Shock Paralyzes the target on 17+.

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.effect: The user receives +1 Combat Stage in their highest non-HP stat.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.effect: Attacks that target the user have a -2 Accuracy Penalty against the user. Does not affect attackers with the Blindsense Capability. Defensive.
